payload.description_html: Reconstructed food web for the Rhaetian Contorta Beds of Bonenburg. Taxa present are based on the marine genera mentioned in Sander et al. (2016). Arrows indicate energy flow from prey to predator. Black arrows represent known predator–prey interactions from other sources. Blue arrows represent inferred relationships based on dentition. Red arrows represent other likely relationships based on ecology. Several silhouettes modified from Cross et al. (2018), Fischer (2012) and Perillo and Heijne (2023)
